create_ParquetReader: create a ParquetReader instance to read data from Parquet files with a custom data folder path
run_ParquetReader_read_file: run the ParquetReader read_file method to yield documents from a single Parquet file
build_ParquetReader_with_adapter: build a ParquetReader with a custom adapter function to transform data dicts into Document objects
test_ParquetReader_limit_skip: test the ParquetReader with a limit and skip parameter to control the number of documents read
review_ParquetReader_batch_size: review the ParquetReader batch_size parameter for controlling how many rows are read per batch
